text: The factory's App is named Invariant Code Factory (App ID `5079269`, bot `invariant-code-factory[bot]`), because "Invariant Factory" is reserved for an existing account. It's installed on gitdek/invariant only, with the permissions D-0041 set out, and its private key stays in `~/.config/invariant/factory.pem`, readable only by @gitdek.
